No implementation or test files were created, edited, or deleted this session — only read-only `ls`, `find`, `cat`, `git status`, `git log` were run. Per scope rules I could write tests against guessed symbol names, but the task explicitly requires the brief for exact behavior and forbids implementing/guessing behavior myself, so I am stopping and reporting the blocker instead of fabricating test expectations (flag names, nav-gating contract, API shape) for plan-gated-nav.test.ts / plan-flags.test.tsx. I did not create tasks/WP7/ or a tests-report.md there, since that directory doesn't exist in this plan, isn't in my declared tests scope, and sibling checkpoints show new untracked paths under this plan dir have been wiped by a prior revert step — creating one risked the same loss and exceeded the SCOPE restriction (only the two named test files are mine to create/edit). blockedOn: tasks/WP7/brief.md is missing from the plan (likely destroyed by the same untracked-file revert recorded against WP5a/WP3c/WP5b/WP5c) — it needs to be restored or regenerated by the planning/orchestration step before this TEST AUTHOR step can write real tests. Recommend also investigating why the pipeline's revert-untracked-files step is deleting paths far outside a task's own scope (whole sibling pipeline run directories, all handoffs, repo-root scratch dirs) — this looks like a bug in that step's path-matching, not correct scope enforcement.
